# 03 · MiniMax H3 — image → video
**Use:** pick the first frame in *Load first frame* → write the shot-list in **prompt** on the middle node → Run.
Everything technical lives inside the subgraph (double-click its title; the breadcrumb brings you back).

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| size (MP) | pixel budget; aspect from your image, **never cropped**; 0.70 ≈ 768×960 (best quality/time) |
| frames | 17k+5 → 124 = 5 s · 226 = 9 s · 294 = 12 s (local max; longer → 03c) |
| seed / shift | same seed + frame = repeatable · shift 12 = official default (series 1) |
| steps / turbo | **quality (default): turbo 0, 30 steps** (20 = −35 % time, slightly softer fabric/hands) · faster: turbo 0.8 + 12 steps · fastest: turbo 1.0 + 8 steps (fingers merge on fast motion) |
| Eros Max | off = official H3 (sharper, clothed scenes) · on = Eros Max finetune (anatomy) |
| SageAttention | on = ≈ 2× faster, same look (series 1); off = exact attention |
| keep first-frame light | ColorMatch against darkening/warming drift; **off** if the light should change or a big new object enters (bus, car) |
| sound / volume | off = no audio track · dB (−6 = half) |
| smooth 48 fps | FILM ×2 (core nodes) |
| cut lead-in (s) | cuts frames + sound at the start (core *Video Slice*); 0 = off · 0.5 = drop a calm "settle" beat written as `0s-0.5s` in the shot-list (+12 frames) |

**Prompt tips:** timed shot-list (`[Shot N] 0s-2s: …`); appearance lock repeats the body/outfit words of the still;
background lock = *the room exactly as in <Picture 1>, nothing added* (listing new objects repaints the background);
`Lighting lock: exposure, white balance and light exactly as in <Picture 1>`; no mood words (warm, dim, cosy) anywhere,
also not in `non_diegetic_music:`; hand contact mid-clip, calm hold at the end; unwanted sounds into `negative:`.
Don't run H3 here while the agent runs one on port 8189 (62 GB RAM is shared).

**Measured:** official RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB, ComfyUI 0.42.4 · **768×960 · 124 f (5 s) · 8 steps · shift 8: 160–184 s** · 640×800 · 73 f: 65–72 s · peak VRAM 15.5–15.9 GB · system RAM 58–60 GB (32B text encoder!) · Eros Max 768×960 · 124 f (5 s) · 8 steps: **158–171 s**, peak VRAM 15.5–15.7 GB, system RAM 59 GB — same as official 03. SFW clothed test (series 0): Eros Max is ≈ 30 % softer than official H3 (Laplacian 56/44/50 vs 79/64/75 start/mid/end); **shift 8 recovers part (61/52/57)**, identity drift slightly higher (13 vs 7). Hands fine, all beats play. Use 05 for what official H3 smears (anatomy); for clothed scenes 03 is sharper.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1> is the first frame. Whole clip is 5 seconds. Live-action. Static medium shot of a fictional 28-year-old woman sitting on a black metal mesh bench inside a glass bus shelter in daylight.
Appearance lock: long wavy copper-red hair, freckles, mature adult face, light everyday makeup, untucked white linen blouse with rolled sleeves, dark-blue high-waisted jeans, small silver pendant, silver hoop earrings, black bag on the bench. Keep face, outfit and proportions exactly as in <Picture 1>.
Background lock: red brick shop with striped awning, yellow curb, glass shelter panels with soft reflections; background stays still apart from natural light flicker.
[Shot 2] 0s-2.5s: she lifts her right hand and tucks a strand of hair behind her ear, then smiles warmly at the camera; small natural breathing and blinking.
[Shot 3] 2.5s-5s: she glances briefly to her left toward the street, looks back at the camera and gives a small playful wink, then relaxes, hands return to her lap and she keeps smiling softly.
camera: handheld phone feel, almost static, very slight natural sway, no zoom, no cuts.
overall_soundscape: quiet city street ambience, distant traffic, a soft breeze, faint footsteps on the pavement.
non_diegetic_music: None.
negative: nudity, revealing clothing, morphing face, identity drift, extra fingers, warped hands, flicker, jitter, text, subtitles, watermark, music, talking.

### 1 · Models
- **official** `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot`; turbo 8-step LoRA as a **strength knob**: 0 = off = best quality
  (30 steps, res_multistep, shift 12 — series 1 winner); 0.8 + 12 steps = faster with a small loss; 1.0 + 8 steps = fastest, softest hands
- **Eros Max** beta5 int8 (community finetune, already turbo) + VBVR Pro attn-only @0.25 → for anatomy official H3 smears;
  ≈ 30 % softer, drifts darker (use *keep first-frame light*)
- text encoder `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq` (32 B → ~58 GB system RAM), video/audio VAEs
- **shift** (MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, audio 3): 8 = sharper; lower = softer, less darkening on Eros
- **SageAttention** (toggle, default on): 8-bit attention, ≈ 2× faster (9 s: 445 → 224 s), same motion and colour (series 1)

widgets_values:
### 5 · Decode + finish
- **drop frame 0**: frame 0 is the input still itself (sharper, other colour) → visible pop
- **keep first-frame light**: ColorMatch mkl of every frame against the first frame — stops the slow darkening/warming drift
- **sound**: H3 audio through a volume stage; off = no audio track
- **smooth 48 fps**: FILM ×2 (core FrameInterpolate, ≈ 30 s per 9 s; beat RIFE 4.7/4.26 on fast hands in series 1); lazy switch, off = never runs
